data: Which layer has more red rectangles across all categories?

To determine which layer has more red rectangles across all categories, I need to:
1. Look at the color gradient from blue to red in each row
2. Count how many red squares appear in each row
3. Compare the number of red squares

Looking at the color gradient:
- Layer 1 shows mostly red squares
- Layer 2 shows fewer red squares than Layer 1
- Layer 3 shows fewer red squares than Layer 2
- Layer 4 shows fewer red squares than Layer 3
- Layer 5 shows fewer red squares than Layer 4
- Layer 6 shows the fewest red squares among all layers

Therefore, Layer 1 has the most red squares across all categories.
Layer 1 has approximately 4 red squares out of 4 categories, while other layers have fewer red squares.
This is confirmed by the highest values in the first row compared to other rows.
